name: How long does a kitchen lighting upgrade take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a kitchen lighting upgrade take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a kitchen lighting upgrade depends on the project's complexity. A simple replacement of existing fixtures might be completed in a single day. However, projects involving new wiring, adding recessed lighting, or integrating smart home controls can take anywhere from a few days to over a week. Factors such as the need for electrical panel upgrades, plaster or drywall repairs, and fixture availability can also influence the timeline. We will provide a clear project schedule after our initial assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Simple kitchen lighting upgrades take a day, while more complex projects with new wiring or smart controls can take several days to over a week.
